transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18) across all regions.
2. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release.
3. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
